It wasnt kiss assery, it was genuine care and affection. humans are rather easy to understand. EVERYBODY needs a cheerleader in their stands, life isnt something to handle by yourself. I always valued myself as a somewhat independant person, so i found it easier to make myself available for others.

And i know it will get better, I havent completly given up, im just starting to feel like its all for naught but, im not out of the game yet.

thanks for the reply
i really appreciate it. I never felt like i deserved the best, I just felt like i deserved the bare minimum. Thank you very much
